notes.title: Upgrades are here!
notes.content:
Hello,

First I want to thank you all who took your time and submitted bugs and suggestions!

Second, game has been updated and here are the changes:
[list]
[*] Upgrades are added - Upgrades are passive bonuses that make you more powerful. Upgrades cost Stars to get. You get stars for placing towers and structures on star pickup and for clearing every 10 waves. Currently there are 16 upgrades.
[*] There is no more Waves goal that you progress through. There is always a goal of 30 waves. If you complete at least 10 waves of previous difficulty new one will be unlocked.
[*] Fixed some strange sound bugs.
[*] Events now pick card from your hand not only from deck and discard pile.
[*] Each leveling of tower card now increases placed tower level by 2 instead of 1.
[*] Bug fix for teleport tower, now enemies won't be infinitely stuck.
[*] Spear tower gets less fire rate for each shot. 
[*] Email promo now moved to options menu from the main.
[/list]

Have fun playing!

notes.title: 1 Year Anniversary!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

It's been a year after release of my first game Towers Deck. During that time more than 3000 of you tried it either in demo or in a full form, thank you all!

During the year I made 9 updated, this one being the 10th.

Now I am working on my next game Seekers of Eclipse which demo is coming on February 23rd - 25th, and you can join it here:
https://subscribepage.io/YjbvQV

About this update:

[list]
[*] New starting cards - now each game you will start with mostly worst cards, and deckbuilding should become more important
[*] Events now happen when you want to - during the preparation, before you expand, you will have to complete an event, that will give you time to spend money or save it up before activating event.
[*] You can now rotate map with 'q' and 'e'
[*] Better and improved tutorial added
[*] Tiles now appear in less random way
[*] If event asks you to pay and you can't you will get a loan.
[*] Lots of bug fixes and balance tweaks
[/list]

Hope you enjoy it,
Emilijus

notes.title: Hunter and Events Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Hunter and Events update is here! Lots of new content, huge increase in replayability and a lot of fixes.

Here is Towers Deck 2.0 Changes:

[u]new features:[/u]
[list]
[*] New Hero "Hunter" has been added. With it's own cards, research tree and a starting special. Giving you an unique combination to try with each hero.
[*] All heroes get starting special power to make each one feel unique from the start.
[*] Events added. Events will appear every wave and will give you a choice that will somehow influence your run. This will increase replayability and add to uniqueness of each run.
[*] Reworked how Market, Forge and Graveyard appear. Now you will get a choice every second turn if you want to visit any, giving you more control over how your deck is built.
[*] Additional difficulty level Nightmare, which will have you defending from all 4 directions.
[*] New terrain added: ruins, flower field and swamp.
[*] 3 new enemies added.
[*] Each hero' research tree got reworked and expanded. Total different research increased from 42 to 70
[*] 11 new Cards
[*] Bestiary added, information about each enemy can be checked in pause menu.
[*] All new character and card art.
[/list]
[u]balance fixes:[/u]
[list]
[*] Every card has been tweaked or changed. Now upgrading a card will have a bigger improvement.
[*] Enemy stats reworked.
[*] Tower stats got reworked. Towers leveling up now is more meaningful.
[*] Terrain stats have been reworked to sometimes give negative stats, but bigger positives. Making the choice of where to build towers more important.
[/list]

Have fun playing!
- Emilijus

notes.title: Towers Deck is Releasing on February 1st !
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I am launching Towers Deck on February 1st! 

Why now?
The plan was to launch it a bit sooner, however I am glad I did not rush it. Got an opportunity to send test version of Towers Deck to a couple of reviewers/streamers and got quite a few tips and suggestions on how I could improve this game before release.
After analyzing the feedback I decided to implement a couple of improvements:
- Tip system to help you find all the game mechanics;
- Balance fixes, made it a bit easier in early runs as it was too tough;
- Lots of bug fixes.

I began developing this game exactly one year ago. It all started when I wanted to play a deckbuilding tower defense game, but could not find any that I enjoyed enough. So the plan was to create a game in one year. With a couple ups and downs here it is - a game that I myself am excited and interested to play and I hope that all of you will be as thrilled to play Towers Deck as I am!
